# Acme is a customer and a vendor. INV-NET and BILL-NET are 100.00 CAD each,
# and a journal entry typed as a payment moves 100.00 from what Acme owes
# (`Assets:Accounts Receivable`) to what is owed to Acme
# (`Liabilities:Accounts Payable`). No split of the entry is off a receivable
# or a payable.
#
# The test puts the entry's receivable split in INV-NET's lot and its payable
# split in BILL-NET's, as GnuCash's View > Lots does, so the entry settles
# both.
#
# Load after `payment_roundtrip_accounts.txt`.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_unposting_an_invoice_netted_against_a_bill_reports_no_bank_payment.py.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

vendor "V001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

2026-02-01 * "Net what Acme owes against what is owed to Acme"
	guid: "f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1"
	txn_type: P
	Liabilities:Accounts Payable 100.00 CAD
		guid: "a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2a2"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -100.00 CAD
		guid: "b3b3b3b3b3b3b3b3b3b3b3b3b3b3b3b3"

invoice "INV-NET"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-10
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-10
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-10
		due: 2026-02-10
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-NET"
		accumulate: true

bill "BILL-NET"
	vendor_id: "V001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-12
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-12
		description: "Supplies"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-12
		due: 2026-02-12
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable"
		memo: "Bill BILL-NET"
		accumulate: true
